notes.title: OpenWorld Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42626761/eb7b5bc32d55caacae323389e4b49683e2de7cc5.png

Descension is Now an OpenWorld Survival Horror Game That features constant new expansions and events. Survive For Six hours in uncharted universes! The gameplay itself is Inspired by game modes like "COD Zombies" and "RE Mercenaries". Descension wants to constantly expand its world through live events, similarly to games like "destiny 2" and "ESO".  The open world will seamlessly expand with themed events that stay forever expanding the multiverse in new and horrific ways.

The OpenWorld Update Will kick off with an event called Season Zero. This event Will be sort of a kickoff event For Descension to regain its footing. We want to be transparent with Our customers and people interested in the project. As a small team of a handful of people in and out. We'd Love for your feedback during Season Zero as the game is still in early Alpha.
